newsitem.title: CHINA: China buys $60 mln equipment from Germany's Wirth.
newsitem.headline: China buys $60 mln equipment from Germany's Wirth.

text.p: The China National Technology Import and Export Corp has signed an agreement with Wirth Co of Germany to import equipment worth $60 million, the China Daily said on Friday.
The contract, signed on Thursday, is for the import of two sets of open-time tunnel boring machines for construction of a tunnel on a railway in northwestern China, the newspaper said.
The purchase was arranged at the request of the Ministry of Railways.

The railway links the ancient city of Xi'an, capital of northwestern Shaanxi province with Ankang in southwestern Sichuan province, and will be an important link between north and south China, it said.
The machinery was bought through international bidding.
